findings.summary: Calloway-Sum outperforms Pellam-Sum on ROUGE-L F1 in all four held-out text domains (scientific, legal, meeting, reviews), with differences ranging from 1.2 to 1.5 percentage points.
findings.scope: Held-out domains: Lindqvist-Sci, Corbin-Legal, Ashdown-Meet, Gable-Reviews; metric ROUGE-L F1 (%), mean over 3 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests were reported, so the consistency of the advantage across domains is descriptive only; significance is not established.

findings.summary: The advantage of Calloway-Sum over Pellam-Sum in held-out domains is similar in magnitude to its in-domain advantage (1.2–1.5 vs. 1.2 percentage points).
findings.scope: All evaluated domains (in-domain and four held-out); metric ROUGE-L F1 (%), mean over 3 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical test compares the differences across domains; the similarity is based on observed means only.

findings.summary: Calloway-Sum also exceeds the Lead-3 extractive baseline in every held-out domain, with margins of 4.6 to 7.3 percentage points.
findings.scope: Held-out domains: Lindqvist-Sci, Corbin-Legal, Ashdown-Meet, Gable-Reviews; metric ROUGE-L F1 (%), mean over 3 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests were reported; the margins are descriptive.

sentences.text: Calloway-Sum outperformed Pellam-Sum on ROUGE-L F1 in all four held-out text domains, with advantages of 1.5 percentage points on Lindqvist-Sci (36.4 vs. 34.9), 1.3 on Corbin-Legal (33.1 vs. 31.8), 1.5 on Ashdown-Meet (29.7 vs. 28.2), and 1.2 on Gable-Reviews (31.5 vs. 30.3).
These held-out advantages (1.2–1.5 percentage points) were similar in magnitude to the in-domain advantage of 1.2 percentage points on Ravenmoor News (41.8 vs. 40.6).

Calloway-Sum also exceeded the Lead-3 extractive baseline in every held-out domain, with margins of 4.6 percentage points on Gable-Reviews (31.5 vs. 26.9), 4.7 on Lindqvist-Sci (36.4 vs. 31.7), 5.2 on Corbin-Legal (33.1 vs. 30.5), and 7.3 on Ashdown-Meet (29.7 vs. 22.4).
However, no statistical tests were reported, so these differences are descriptive only and their significance is not established.
